description: Monte Generoso is the limestone summit on the Swiss-Italian border, seen from the Swiss side looking north over Lake Lugano and the Melide causeway toward the Alps. The Swiss summit lies in Val Mara; Capolago, in Mendrisio, is only the valley station of the railway. No observatory dome is shown, because that instrument was removed in 2021, and no railway mark is readable. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy, with sun through broken cloud and no rain.
